name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Pedestal Shim
tagline: SHIM FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED PAVER FLOORING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Pedestal Shim is an accessory used on top of adjustable pedestals to create a dampener to account for minute height differences between the pedestal and the paver, created from the uneven surface of the installation substrate. Shims are manufactured from recycled thermoplastic elastomer (TPE) and may be cut into 4 corners to support individual paver corners. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Pedestal Shim, with its cushioning material, fills the small gaps also to prevent rocking and knocking of pavers on the surface.
